selection: All 49 distinct expanded words in the fixed 52-word synthetic passage plus nested seeded distractors from the full corrected Latin dictionary.
scope: Truth-assisted vocabulary construction includes continuation spellings. This is a deliberately easier diagnostic, not blind recovery, full-vocabulary calibration or language evidence. Full alphabet, generating key, cipher bounds, training prefixes and original continuation remain fixed.
stopping_rule: Nine short fits only; checkpoint each result. UNKNOWN has no predictive score. No seed search, added budgets, key repair, or Voynich fitting.
